description: Properties panel for the wireframe editor. Shows editable fields for the currently selected element(s). Supports single-select (all PropDef fields grouped by category, plus Layout X/Y/W/H and Element/ZIndex sections) and multi-select (intersection of common props, Mixed indicator when values differ). All mutations are routed through the cascaded WireframeCommandStack when available. Text and number inputs use per-field debounce (350 ms); dropdowns and checkboxes apply immediately. Changing a size prop with SizePresets defined automatically resizes the element. With an EMPTY selection the panel shows the Canvas (device preset select - Desktop 1440x900, Laptop 1280x800, Tablet 1024x768, iPhone 14 390x844, Android 360x800, Custom - plus width/height and Apply, all through the undoable ResizeCanvasCommand), Page (rename of the active page) and Grid (show grid, grid size) sections. The Element section has a Name field (undoable RenameElementCommand; the name is the element's aria-label and tooltip on the canvas) and a Delete element button.

parameters.name: ShowGrid
parameters.description: Whether the grid is shown (the Grid section toggle). Never assigned by the component - it keeps local state, raises ShowGridChanged and re-adopts the host value when the parameter changes.

parameters.name: ShowGridChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new value when the user toggles Show grid.

parameters.name: GridSize
parameters.description: Snap-to-grid cell size in pixels (the Grid section input, 0-128; 0 = snapping off). Never assigned by the component.

parameters.name: GridSizeChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new cell size when the user edits the grid size.

parameters.name: OnCanvasResized
parameters.description: Raised AFTER a ResizeCanvasCommand was pushed (device preset or Apply), so the host can update its canvas.

parameters.name: OnDelete
parameters.description: Raised by the Delete element button. With a delegate the host performs the deletion; without one the panel pushes a RemoveElementsCommand itself and raises DocumentChanged.

parameters.name: SelectedIds
parameters.description: IDs of the currently selected elements. Empty = no selection shown.

parameters.name: OnCopyStyle
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests copy style from the selected element.

parameters.name: OnPasteStyle
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests paste style to the selected elements.

parameters.name: OnPasteSize
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests paste size to the selected elements.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the panel wrapper.

parameters.name: ComponentScope
parameters.description: Optional application scope used to resolve custom wireframe components.

examples.title: Properties panel bound to canvas selection
examples.code:
<TmWireframeDesignerCanvas @ref="_canvas"
                           Document="_document"
                           DocumentChanged="d => _document = d"
                           OnSelectionChanged="ids => _selectedIds = ids" />

<TmWireframePropertiesPanel Document="_document"
                             DocumentChanged="d => _document = d"
                             SelectedIds="_selectedIds" />

@code {
    private WireframeDocument _document = new();
    private string[] _selectedIds = [];
}
